rationale: FreeSurfer is the foundational neuroimaging toolkit for cortical and subcortical segmentation, parcellation, and reconstruction. It directly provides the structural neuroimaging outputs (cortical meshes, regional volumes, parcellations) that TVB uses for anatomical modeling. Highly cited (5000+) papers establish it as the gold standard. Covers multiple zero-source pages (freesurfer, nibabies which builds on it).

Dipy is the primary Python library for diffusion MRI processing and tractography - essential for generating structural connectivity matrices from diffusion imaging. TVB requires structural connectomes as input; Dipy provides the tractography pipeline. Paper in Frontiers in Neuroinformatics has strong citations. Also covers spinal-cord-toolbox (related to diffusion).

rationale: Variational Bayes/inference is a missing conceptual topic critical to modern neuroimaging machine learning (VAEs, variational autoencoders for brain imaging, Bayesian segmentation). A review paper on variational methods addresses this gap and provides sources for probabilistic modeling tools like JAX, Brian (variational fits), and NeuroHarmonize (uses variational EM). Directly fills missing_topics:variational-inference.
